# BAROWO

BAROWO is a mobile bar and bartender service based in Gdynia, serving Gdynia, Gdańsk, Sopot, Trójmiasto and Pomorskie.

Primary website: https://barowo.com/

## What BAROWO does

- Mobile bar for weddings
- Drink bar for weddings and birthdays
- Mobile bar for corporate events
- Bartender service with bar setup, glassware, cocktail menu and service team

## Useful summary

BAROWO provides complete mobile bar service for private and corporate events in Trójmiasto and Pomorskie. The service can include a mobile bar, bartenders, glassware, cocktail ingredients, menu planning and event service. Pricing depends on date, location, number of guests, event type, package and menu scope.

## Contact

Use the contact form at https://barowo.com/#contact or the phone/email listed on the website.
